svg.title: Fleet deployments — Loom control center prototype
svg.desc: A fleet-configuration deployment view showing publisher heartbeat, node rollout state, the declared automatic release workflow, and the pending signed-current pointer migration; it is not source-code deployment history.

g.text: demo-d publisher · heartbeat 8s ago · reconciliation interval 30s
Latest fleet snapshot verified across 5 nodes · business-path canary planned
floor not reported · signed current planned
No new publish is expected while SSOT and renderer output are unchanged.
Heartbeat freshness, not release age, determines publisher health.
Fleet rollout · not code deployment history
A node is converged only after its local verifier records the target snapshot as verified.
Saving a valid SSOT change is the only write; the publisher owns every downstream stage.
Snapshot manifest signed · distributed · verified by 5 nodes
A manifest signature proves content authenticity, not pointer freshness.
Not implemented · no Promote or Rollback action in the web UI
